entries.land_description: 22 acres, good tools and equipment, dogs, cats, chickens, ducks, guineas, peabirds and 60 zillion bees.
entries.notes: oriented homestead whose main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry. Off-farm income is derived from graphic design, photography and writing for the organic agriculture journals. We also produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name of Armadillo Mountain. Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land. Longer-term apprenticeships/work exchanges are a possibility. Would also trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture (particularly dryland and forage systems) for some good, solid vocational skills, especially carpentry and stone masonry. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 22 acres, good tools and equipment, dogs, cats, chickens, ducks, guineas, peabirds and 60 zillion bees.

entries.land_description: housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/caretakers, girl children, boy children (under 10 years), nonlesbian women, dogs only if restrained
entries.notes: We are two wimmin caretaking OWL since Aug 82. OWL is needing energy and money support from wimmin to stay open for wimmin & children. No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence. I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here. We welcome: new members/caretakers, girl children, boy children (under 10 years), nonlesbian women, dogs only if restrained, donations. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 147 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working the land. Inactive group with hopes to revive.

entries.welcomed_groups: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: OWLT is in the process of buying OWL FARM (see above). Support for the farm and trust comes from donations from those women who believe in land for women. A quarterly newsletter is printed, $5/year. Land trust meetings are held about every three months at the farm. A collective of women (the number fluctuates) caretakes the farm. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women.

entries.land_description: housing/permanent structures, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: We are a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop. We grow food and tender our emotional and spiritual depths. And we make art and song that celebrate woman. We invite women to our workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi several times during the year. We are unable to welcome visitors at other times. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: housing/permanent structures, electricity/privy, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: We are a partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres of forested property. We manage our woods by thinning and reforestation, where necessary, for selective timber harvest and firewood. There is one woman-built cabin, a few out buildings, a garden, chickens, and pets. We are not separatists and have male friends that come on our land. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity/privy, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: housing/permanent structures, outdoor toilets, electricity with generator and batteries, camping space, woods, gardens, women living and working with the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: nonlesbian women, women to help on projects
entries.notes: A rural feminist publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image) with strong interests in photography, (summer Ovulars), ecology and alternative technology. We are 57 & 60 years old. We enjoy the company and help of women of all ages who can adapt to our simple lifestyle for short or long visits. Rules: no men, guns, pets, drugs or dope. Smoking limited to outdoors gravel area. $4/day/woman includes vegetarian meals. We welcome: nonlesbian women, women to help on projects. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 6+ acres, housing/permanent structures, outdoor toilets, electricity with generator and batteries, camping space, woods, gardens, women living and working with the land.

entries.welcomed_groups: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, males (during off season only, Nov-March)
entries.notes: Gabriel's is a women's guesthouse located in the center of Provincetown, a resort area on the tip of Cape Cod. We are one block from the nearest beach, have both rooms and apartments, private and shared baths, TVs, a common room, coffee and toast, hot tub and garden patio. Call or write for descriptive brochure. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, males (during off season only, Nov-March). We have/are: housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.

We are a womyn's rooming/guest house situated on a large island off the coast of Maine. Rooms are $21 including tax. The house is a large Victorian, partially restored, one bathroom, kitchen use, large parlour. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 1 dog, 1 cat, house, plumbing/electricity.

We have tried multiple-ownership (partnership) type of land holding. The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually. Some of us persevere in the spirit. We cannot guarantee to answer letters, but if you are prepared to spend a little time in the area, a land search may be fruitful. A large wimmin's community exists.
